lesson.subtitle: Lesson 23 -- Small Talk and Keeping It Going
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Paula Porto de Oliveira Fornazari | Lesson 23 -- Small Talk and Keeping It Going

items.situation: It is raining, and you meet your neighbor at the door. Start the conversation.
tips: Positive sentence, negative tag, voice down.

items.situation: You think your new colleague is from Canada. Check it.
tips: You are from Canada, aren't you?
With be, the tag uses be.

items.situation: Your friend did not come to the dinner. Check it, kindly.
tips: You didn't come to the dinner, did you?

items.situation: Correct me: 'You like coffee, isn't it?'
You want to change the topic, and then end the conversation. Say two sentences.
tips: By the way, are you going to the market on Saturday? ... Anyway, I have to go. Let's keep in touch!
By the way opens a new topic. Anyway closes it.

listenings.text: Good morning, St. Augustine! It is going to be another hot weekend, isn't it? On Saturday, it will be hot and humid, but there will be a nice breeze in the afternoon. You know the farmers market downtown, don't you? It opens on Saturday morning at eight, so go early, before the sun gets too strong. And if you take your dog to the beach, please bring water for your dog, and a leash. The beach is busy on weekends, isn't it? Anyway, have a great weekend, and stay cool!

Hi Ana Paula, it's Mike, from the dog park. You remember me, don't you? The guy with the puppy. I bumped into your husband at the supermarket yesterday, and he gave me your number. I hope that's okay. So, a group of us have a dog meetup every Sunday, at eight in the morning, by the beach. Your girls get along with other dogs, don't they? Please bring them, and bring a leash for the parking lot. By the way, there is coffee after the walk. Anyway, call me back. Let's keep in touch!

extra_audio.text: Good morning! It is a beautiful day, isn't it? It really is. You have a dog too, don't you? Yes, a puppy. By the way, I am Mike. Nice to meet you, Mike. I am Ana Paula. Anyway, I have to go. Let's keep in touch!
